title: Electronic Health Records Incident Response
description: EHR system incidents affecting patient care operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on patient care operations
Notify clinical leadership of system status
Activate EHR vendor support if applicable
Implement manual documentation procedures if needed
investigation_steps: Verify integration points with clinical systems
resolution_steps: Restart EHR application services following vendor procedures
Clear application cache if performance issues
Escalate to EHR vendor for complex issues
verification: Test patient record access and retrieval
Check integration with pharmacy and lab systems
special_considerations: Coordinate with clinical staff for patient safety
Document any workarounds for patient care
